description:
Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.


Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.

It wraps Suwayomi's GraphQL API in a lightweight Tauri app — no Electron overhead.
# Moku v0.10.4
**Released:** August 22, 2026
> "Getting ready for the next chapter."

## Improvements
• Added series context menu options to move downloads up/down in the queue
• Collapsed the downloads queue by series, with a new dropdown, confirmation modal, and reorder context menu
• Collapsed series history, reordered tabs, and added per-series deletion
• Replaced chapter list pagination with a smooth scrollbar view

## Bug Fixes
• Fixed a navigation softlock when unmounting the browse route
• Fixed library filter persistence and updated the Recently Read API
• Fixed GraphQL tracking-unlink call to use RecordID
• Fixed the MangaPreview add-folder scroll handler
• Fixed reader-to-tracker sync
• Removed content-filter source influence on unrelated results
• Fixed the version comparison function in About settings
• Fixed the search-all filter looping back to default, and search-tab-dependent concurrency pinging

## Notes
• Prepares the app for the upcoming Tsunagu backend migration — updating in place from 0.10.4 to 0.10.5+ will require a manual migration step
• Dropdown menu portal rework still in progress (#102)
• "Update All" button issue still under investigation (#105)
• App data wipe on update still under investigation (#104)
• Downloads recognition on open still under investigation (#103)

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/moku-project/Moku/compare/v0.10.3...v0.10.4
